name: Hanohano
summary: Hanohano is a proposed movable deep-ocean liquid-scintillator observatory. An oceanic site far from continental crust and reactors would provide a distinctive mantle-geoneutrino measurement; deployment near reactors could instead address oscillation physics.
detection_principle: A large submerged scintillator target would tag electron antineutrinos through inverse beta decay. Ocean depth suppresses cosmic backgrounds, while relocation changes the balance of crust, mantle and reactor contributions.
